question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is: **risen up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"raised up"** means to lift or elevate something to a higher position or level. (ऊपर उठाना)
 
• **"risen up"** refers to something that has moved from a lower to a higher position, often used in a more figurative or passive sense. (उठ गया)
 
 
• **Example:** The sun has risen up over the horizon, marking the start of a new day.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct choice in the context of the sentence is **'risen up'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **risen up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **raised up** (ऊपर उठाना): To lift or elevate something to a higher position or level.

 
 
• **Example:** The workers raised up the heavy beams with the help of a crane.
 
 
 
• **raise in** (में उठाना): This phrase is not commonly used in standard English and may be considered incorrect.
 
• **rise in** (में वृद्धि): To increase in a particular aspect or area.
 
 
• **Example:** There has been a rise in the number of tourists visiting the city.
